name: levelry
description: Create and edit a visual knowledge canvas with ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: A visual canvas for notes, plans, and diagrams
interface.longDescription: Open your Levelry canvas in ChatGPT. Edit documents and layers manually or ask ChatGPT to work on the selected project. Requires a Levelry account; AI runs in ChatGPT under its plan usage limits.
defaultPrompt: Organize my ideas into a diagram in Levelry.
